description: The Ironboxes on this API key's account, the sandboxes where agents trade on paper next to Hyperliquid: id, name, state (creating, running, stopped, deleted or error), size, mode, runtime and markets. Without a key there are no saved boxes, and the answer says how to make a trial box with create_ironbox.
name: list_ironboxes

activity_url.description: Where to watch this box. Shown only with base_url

base_url.description: Set the Hyperliquid SDK's base_url to this. Shown only when a paper box is created or rotated

dashboard.description: Where the user manages it on ironflow.sh

expires_at.description: When a trial box ends at the latest, Unix milliseconds

markets.description: Markets the agent trades: perps, outcomes, spot

message.description: What happens next, from the API

mode.description: paper: simulated funds, never a real order

paper.description: True on a paper box: the agent's own simulated Hyperliquid account

snippet.description: A first Python program for this box. Shown only when created or rotated

starting_balance_usd.description: Starting balance of a new paper box

state.description: creating, running, stopped, deleted or error

strategies_url.description: Where to start strategies on this box. Shown only with base_url

trial.description: True on a keyless trial box

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: List Ironboxes
